definitions.L_big: ledger; at least one balance |b| in [100, 2000] (each account big w.p. 1/2, >= 1; big = sign x uniform{100..2000}; others from gen_start's +-99 recorded pool); event env.gen_event (recorded marginals), status as drawn; rows whose event leaves the state unchanged rejected
definitions.L_void: ledger; env.gen_start + env.gen_event with status void, where the same event posted would change the state; gold = unchanged
definitions.R_wrap: register add (50) or mix (50), raw sum outside [0, 96] (wrap or underflow); env.gen_start + env.gen_event
definitions.R_boundary: register conditional; other := threshold + d, d uniform over the offsets in {-1, 0, +1} that keep it in [0, 96]; value != 0 mod 97; env.gen_start + env.gen_event
definitions.P_inapp: prerequisite action (env.gen_action_library) inapplicable (pre_on unmet or pre_off set) where applying it anyway would change the state; gold = unchanged (FDS oracle convention)
definitions.P_appdel: applicable prerequisite action whose delete clears a set bit not restored by add

frame: Titan's trained one-step frame: rcwmt.env.one_step_messages(family, before, event) (SYSTEM_ONE)
gold: rcwmt.env.dumps(rcwmt.env.step(family, before, event)); rcwmt.env.cross_check (validated FDS oracle) passed on every row
scoring: PREREG-L1 C6: correct iff rcwmt.env.parse_state(family, prediction, lenient=True) == json.loads(gold)
exclusion: no (before, event) payload and no operative content (FDS generate.operative_key) of any row equals one of any source below; payloads and operative contents unique within the bank

historical.harvest: rcwmt.bank.load_exclusions() == FDS generate.harvest_exclusions(), re-implemented line for line with one change: files named HSKILL_CONFIRM_V2* are skipped by name before any open (the operator-reserved HSKILL-CONFIRM-002 is never opened or hashed)
